name: John Egbert
source:
The first character you meet in both Homestuck and the first Volume of Pesterquest. A young man just turning 13 the day the protagonist meets him.

A seemingly naive boy who lives with his father. John has a penchant for pranks and enjoys bad movies, Con Air in particular.

[spoiler]An alternate universe version of John is seen in Volume 11 as the taxidermied corpse of Jane's grandfather.[/spoiler]
